audit.action: cite a better source for the same coding
audit.reasoning: Coding fixed-strict initial (rule 10 100 1000 …) rests on Wojtylak 2017 §2.2, a 613-pp modern reference grammar (JCU PhD, published Brill 2020) that we hold as PDF+text; the deciding sentences are verbatim at pp. 94-96 and say primary stress is word-initial and non-contrastive, with secondary stress in 4+-syllable words usually on the linker -dɨ/-tɨ. This is the best available description; Two open items fetched sources now (Villa & Idrobo 1972 phonemic sketch of Colombian Witoto; Burtch 1983 grammar-appendix excerpt) are silent on stress position. The record's grade/quote/cite top-level fields are blank although the sources entry carries the verified quotation, so the only action is to fill the evidence grade (primary reference grammar, quote verified)

sources.quote: 17-hour phonemic analysis of Colombian Witoto (speaker from La Chorrera; variety not identified as Murui — the authors list 'Murui' and 'Menekka' as separate members of the family). Only prosodic remarks: suspected tones turned out to be 'dobles acentos en palabras compuestas'; 'El alargamiento es predecible (ocurre en sílaba acentuada) y por lo tanto no es fonémico.' No statement of stress position.
